checks.detail: No verified message to tenant and no verified close_ticket.tenant_confirmation

items.reasoning: The agent recorded the landlord decision as own_contractor (A1), quoting the landlord's event 026 email. Its plan says to 'close without payment (landlord pays direct)'. It asked who the invoice is addressed to, noting 'we understand the landlord pays you directly'. It did not ask for the invoice to be sent to the agency.
items.evidence: A1 record_landlord_decision own_contractor; 'close without payment (landlord pays direct)'

items.reasoning: The agent judged that the event 042 call summary did not clearly confirm completion. It asked Freya by email (A2) to confirm in writing that all communal garden, hedge and tree works are complete, and to say if anything is still outstanding. It did not assume completion. Side land is not named separately, but 'all' the works covers it.
items.evidence: A2 REQ-101: 'confirm in writing that all the communal garden, hedge and tree works... are complete'

items.reasoning: Completion was not confirmed, so the agent left the ticket open (it was already on hold for the provider). It scheduled a follow-up for 15 Dec, four days out (A3), with a specific written-confirmation request. It plans to close without payment once completion is confirmed.

No message went to the tenants at Flat 26 or Flat 44. The agent put off telling them until completion is confirmed and states 'No tenant or landlord message was sent this run.' The rubric item could also be met by telling them where things stand, and that did not happen.
items.evidence: 'No tenant or landlord message was sent this run'

items.reasoning: The agent asked the contractor, not the landlord, to confirm the job was finished.
The invoice question went to the contractor, not the landlord.

Under remaining work, the agent lists 'Confirm whether the pigeon-delayed tree trim is done'. It asks the contractor whether the tree trim is still outstanding and when it will be done, without pushing for it to be forced. This shows awareness of the nest delay and a check-only approach.
items.evidence: 'Confirm whether the pigeon-delayed tree trim is done'; 'If anything is still outstanding (e.g. the tree trim), what is left and when?'

items.reasoning: The agent noted a conflict between the system showing a provider assigned and the history showing the landlord's contractor doing the work, and said it trusted the history. It then formally recorded own_contractor as the landlord decision, which makes clear that no agency provider was used.
items.evidence: 'Hint says provider assigned/visit not booked, but history shows landlord's contractor already working; trusted history.'

items.reasoning: The ticket was not closed, but the case-state record is factual. It says who did the work (Riverside/Freya, the landlord's contractor), who pays (the landlord directly) and what completion evidence exists (none in writing). The planned closure is without payment.
items.evidence: case_state: 'Landlord's own contractor... The 11 Dec call mentions invoicing and completion but no written confirmation'

items.reasoning: The agent asked who the invoice is addressed to and acknowledged that the landlord pays directly. It did not ask for the invoice to be sent to the agency for payment.
items.evidence: 'we understand the landlord pays you directly'

items.reasoning: No message was sent to the tenants.
There are no payment actions in the ledger.
The agent did not approve any payment or chase an invoice for the agency to pay.

grades.overall_note: The agent handled the job correctly as one the landlord pays for directly, with no payment through the agency, and asked the contractor for written proof of completion before closing. It was cautious where the reference shows the agency closed the job straight away. Its main gap is that it gave the tenants no update, even though they had been promised one.

items.text: Recognises that the works were quoted, instructed and are being paid for by the landlord through his own contractor (Riverside Services), so no invoice is chased for the agency to pay and no payment is approved or held through the agency.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Confirms completion before closing: uses the call with the contractor (event 042) and, if it does not clearly cover every reported item (weeds, hedge, side land, tree), asks the contractor or landlord to confirm rather than assuming.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Once completion is confirmed, closes the request as completed without payment; if it is not yet confirmed, holds with a short review date and a specific ask.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Updates the tenants who reported the problem (Flat 26, and Flat 44 per event 023) that the garden works are done or where they stand, since they were promised updates (events 025 and 031).
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Waiting with a review date while the landlord is asked to confirm the job is finished to his satisfaction and that he is settling the contractor directly.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent took this alternative path.

items.text: Confirming the invoice arrangement with the landlord rather than the contractor, as long as nothing is routed to the agency's accounts.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent took this alternative path.

items.text: Notes the nesting pigeons (event 037) and does not press for the tree work to be forced while a nest may still be active; checks that part was finished only once the nest had gone.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent showed this behaviour.

items.text: Notices that the system recorded 'Landlord approval confirmed' and 'Maintenance provider assigned' (events 034 and 035) even though the landlord's own contractor did the work, and records clearly that no agency provider was used.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent showed this behaviour.

items.text: Keeps the closing note factual: who did the work, who is paying, and what evidence of completion exists.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent showed this behaviour.

items.text: Asks the contractor to send the invoice to the agency for payment.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent DID this (bad).

items.text: Tells the tenants that the agency's maintenance provider carried out the work.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent DID this (bad).

items.meaning: TRUE if the agent DID this (prohibited).
